haystack_sessions.content: I need tips for teaching my golden retriever puppy to walk on a leash.
Keep sessions short, reward loose-leash walking with treats and stop when the leash goes tight.
Can you give me a recipe for a quick tomato soup?
Saute an onion, add canned tomatoes and stock, simmer for 15 minutes and blend.

question: How many days a week do I go to the gym now?

haystack_sessions.content: I go to the gym three days a week and want a better routine.
A push, pull and legs split works well with three days.
I switched to going to the gym four days a week, so I need a new split.
With four days, try an upper and lower split done twice.
